::: {.recap}
**Where we are.** Value methods need a max over actions. This module asks one question: *Can we improve the policy directly?*
:::

## What you will build {#build}

In this module you will:

- Derive the policy gradient theorem with the log-derivative trick and implement REINFORCE.
- Show that an action-independent baseline leaves the expected gradient unchanged and measure the variance change.
- Implement GAE with terminated and truncated handled, and measure its bias and variance across lambda.
- Implement an actor-critic loss and compare it with REINFORCE at a fixed budget.

## Before you start {#before}

- [Module 9 · Debugging and evaluating RL](/modules/09-debugging-evaluation.qmd) and its lab: this module builds on what it left open.

- No API keys or paid services.
